title: Salamander heating element flickering
description: Element on the left salamander cuts out every few minutes during service.

title: Blast chiller not pulling down — chili hit 88°F at the 2 h check
description: Blast chiller shows error E4 and cannot bring a 6 gal chili batch below 70°F within 2 hours. Batch was reheated and re-cooled with ice wands. Until fixed, all cooling must use ice baths + ice wands in 2-in pans. Vendor visit needed.

title: Hood suppression inspection overdue after flare-up on grill #1
description: Grease flare-up reached the hood on grill #1 during Saturday service. The suppression inspection sticker expired last month. Vendor needs to inspect before Friday; until then no high-flame searing on grill #1.

title: Grill short-staffed for Friday dinner (2 of 4 cooks)
description: Two grill cooks called out for Friday. Need two cover shifts or a reduced grill menu. Shift scheduler shows no one available yet.

title: Fryer oil down to 1 case — delivery was short
description: Harbor Foodservice delivered 2 of 6 cases of canola frying oil. After the Wednesday change we have 1 case left; par is 4. We will run out by Saturday dinner without an order.

title: Walk-in reading 43°F at 6 AM check
description: Display 43°F, probe in the milk 42°F. Door closer is slow again. Product moved per the alarm SOP; vendor called.

title: Fryer oil changes skipped two nights running
description: Fryer log shows no change Monday or Tuesday; TPM read 27% this morning. Close checklist was signed anyway. Need to find out who is closing fry and retrain on the change schedule.

title: Dish machine sanitizer reading 30 ppm
description: Chlorine strip read 30 ppm at shift start (min 50). Re-primed once, still low. Using the 3-compartment sink.

title: Flat-top has a cold spot front-left
description: Front-left quarter of the flat-top reads 90°F lower than the rest. Burgers there are coming out under temp. Using the back half only for now.

title: Chicken stock yield down to 26 qt
description: Last three batches yielded 26–27 qt instead of 32. Suspect simmer too hard overnight.

title: Salamander slow to heat on the pass side
description: Takes ~25 min to reach temp in the morning, used to be 10. Right burner looks weaker than the left.

title: Croissants over-proofing in the new proofer
description: Since the proofer was replaced, croissants collapse at the 2 h mark. Recipe card still has the old proofer settings.

title: Grill ticket printer jams during rush
description: Printer jams on long tickets (8+ items). Blocked: waiting on POS vendor to ship a replacement cutter.
